title: What they said at the time

clips.q: After being a net user of cash since our inception as a result of rapid store growth, we became a net generator of cash in the fourth quarter of 2000.
Our decision not to extend our offers was reached after a careful review of all of the available facts and circumstances.
clips.who: **John Antioco**, Blockbuster chief executive, Associated Press, Mar 25, 2005[^9]

clips.q: This is what we had said all along, that we thought (Blockbuster’s bid) was going to run into problems.
clips.who: **Larry Denedy**, Hollywood spokesman, Associated Press, Mar 25, 2005[^9]

clips.q: For the near term, we do not intend to make additional significant investments in either a movie kiosk program or the integration of an online video rental channel.
clips.who: **Movie Gallery**, annual report for fiscal 2007, filed Dec 2008[^13]

clips.q: Hollywood Video may no longer be the neighborhood rental store, but the mission is still the same: help people find something worth watching.
clips.who: **hollywoodvideo.com**, “About The New Hollywood Video”, read Oct 2026[^22]
